explanation: Combined result of the study publication record with main's bundle-reader adoption, study-selection module and HypoMap atlas client. Study record: studyRecord.test.ts pins the record at its interface (a PMID named only in the citation, the source record's only linked PMID, empty DOIs, DOI-only and case-insensitive DOI matches, https-only links, the default contrast and labels, per-track arm counts); seoPages.test.ts drops its identity cases and keeps layout, and keeps main's check that every study-page track label equals readDatasetFromDisk; seoStudyContent.test.ts passes a record instead of raw meta. From main: queryIndexCorpus.test.ts, the listDiskCorpus and jsonpHeader cases in bundleReader.test.ts, deployGuards locator fixtures, studySelection.test.tsx, lazyChunkBoundaries.test.ts, hypomapAtlasClient.test.ts and hypomapFixture.ts, with geneStudyScope.test.ts and hypomapMetrics.test.ts removed.
